campos.nombre: Fermion: VL6180X ToF Distance Ranging Sensor (5-100mm) (Breakout)
campos.descripcion: The sensor uses FlightSense™ technology for accurate distance measurement (5-100mm, up to 200mm) and includes an ambient light sensor. It features strong anti-interference.
campos.especificaciones:
Specification
Power Supply Voltage: 3.3V~5V
Operating Current: ＜5mA
Measuring Distance: 5-100mm
Emitter: 940nm invisible laser (VCSEL)
I2C Address: 0x29
Operating Temperature Range: -20℃~85℃
Product Size: 19*18mm / 0.75*0.71 inch

The sensor uses FlightSense™ technology for accurate distance measurement (5-100mm, up to 200mm) and includes an ambient light sensor. It features strong anti-interference.

Uncover the precision of VL6180X sensor with up to 200mm ranging capability. Combines distance and ambient light measurement in one package!
